summary: All 6 acceptance criteria fully satisfied. The safe-jit wrappers (_maybe_jit, _maybe_partial_jit) are a necessary and minimal scope extension discovered during implementation to prevent module-level crashes when jit=None, which is required for AC-5. No out-of-scope additions beyond these wrappers and the new test file (which addresses code review finding F1). All three code review findings (F1 test coverage, F2 exception chain, F3 logger) have been resolved.

criteria_met.1: Module-level try/except ImportError replaced with try/except Exception (line 44 diff)
criteria_met.2: JAX globals set to None on failure: jax = jnp = jit = vmap = lax = None; _JXF = _JX_INT = None
criteria_met.3: _require_jax() guard function added and called first line of GPUBacktestEngine.__init__()
criteria_met.4: When JAX available: all existing behavior preserved (58 tests pass); safe wrappers apply jit as before
criteria_met.5: When JAX broken: importing gpu_engine.py does not crash (globals set to None); GPUBacktestEngine instantiation raises RuntimeError with original error and preserved exception chain
criteria_met.6: All existing tests pass (58/58) plus 3 new subprocess-based tests for JAX-failure path

safe_jit_wrappers_assessment.necessity: Required because @jit decorators at module level crash when jit=None, which would violate AC-5 (import must not crash). Without these wrappers, the module would raise AttributeError when trying to apply @jit to functions.
safe_jit_wrappers_assessment.scope: Minimal: two small functions in gpu_engine.py only, applied to existing internal functions. No new public API.
safe_jit_wrappers_assessment.correctness: _maybe_jit returns jit(fn) when jit available, else fn unchanged. _maybe_partial_jit returns partial(jit, **kwargs) when jit available, else identity decorator. Both are equivalent to original behavior when JAX is present.

code_review_findings_addressed.F1_test_coverage: Added tests/unit/test_gpu_engine_jax_failure.py with 3 parameterized subprocess tests (RuntimeError, AttributeError, ImportError). Tests verify: (a) import does not crash, (b) _require_jax() raises RuntimeError, (c) GPUBacktestEngine instantiation raises RuntimeError with original error and exception chain.
code_review_findings_addressed.F2_exception_chain: _jax_import_error stores exception object (not str); _require_jax() raises RuntimeError(...) from _jax_import_error, preserving __cause__.
code_review_findings_addressed.F3_logger: logger.warning(...) added in except block with type name and message, using existing module logger.

details.guard_placement: GPUBacktestEngine.__init__() - first statement after docstring, before any jax.* attribute access
details.error_message_clarity: Clear RuntimeError with original error message and preserved exception chain
